message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Formatting check

on: 
  pull_request:

jobs:

  lint:
    name: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: JohnnyMorganz/stylua-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          args: --check . 
          version: latest",
  "rationale": "The workflow has a single lint job with no timeout bound. Adding timeout-minutes bounds the job against runaway consumption while preserving every step, the required formatting check, and all trigger/branch behavior. Measured CI workflow experiments for the timeout patterns (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT) added timeout-minutes to jobs and reported all runs still succeeding with reduced elapsed time. The change is minimal, introduces no new network access, secrets, privileged actions, or publishing/deployment steps, and does not weaken permissions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-a14b642d809bf336", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}

Original workflow:

name: Formatting check

on: 
  pull_request:

jobs:

  lint:
    name: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

Evidence patterns available:
- P-LIT-GHA-CACHE: Cache dependency downloads - not really applicable, no dependency installation here

- P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE: Pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows - ci_service scope
- P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE: Suppress schedules during repository inactivity - ci_service scope
- P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST: Run previously failing jobs first - ci_service scope
- P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT: Derive timeout candidates from successful history - workflow_yaml scope, preconditions: Successful job history is representative
- P-LIT-PRIORITIZE: Prioritize tests - build_configuration scope
- P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY: Prioritize queued builds - ci_service scope
- P-LIT-SELECT: Select tests - build_configuration scope
- P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT: Select builds - ci_service scope

- P-LIT-BAZEL-INCREMENTAL: Bazel - not applicable
- P-LIT-BAZEL-DEPS: Bazel - not applicable
- P-LIT-ENV-CACHE: Reuse validated build environments - ci_service scope
- P-LIT-UNAFFECTED-STEPS: Skip steps using traced dependencies - ci_service scope
- P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR: Repair evidenced configuration smells - workflow_yaml scope
- P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION: research_only scope
- P-LIT-UNUSED-OUTPUTS: Remove genuinely unused outputs - workflow_yaml scope
- P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE: Share cached build dependencies - ci_service scope
- P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE: Reuse work across compatible configurations - build_configuration scope
- P-LIT-UNUSED-DEP-SKIP: Evaluate skipping unused-dependency updates - ci_service scope
